execution_policy: Direct celld only, against a fresh isolated disposable store; no workerd substitute or in-memory KV mock earns evidence.
source_contract_note: kv.js implements strong reads while promising weaker public freshness. These are source-contract regression candidates, never blanket Cloudflare parity assertions.

read.supports: Read one live row per requested key, decode each result, and represent missing rows as null.

write.supports: Public put encodes one entry; SQL upsert replaces value, tag, metadata and expiry fields.

delete.supports: Delete targets exact names in one transaction; deleteBulk accepts a scalar or a bounded array.

value.supports: ArrayBuffers and views are copied, honoring byteOffset and byteLength; reads select text, JSON, ArrayBuffer or stream decoding.

stream.supports: Drain all stream chunks to a bounded owned byte array, release the reader lock, then write bytes.

metadata.supports: Serialize metadata at public put and parse it per read/list; a stored JSON null is distinct from absent SQL metadata on list.

bulk.supports: Bulk input is string-normalized in input order; returned Map preserves null holes and standard duplicate-key Map behavior.

list.supports: SQL bytewise ORDER BY name and limit+1 lookahead; public cursor is emitted only for a nonterminal page.

prefix.supports: A bounded SQL range plus BINARY substr with code-point length matches the literal case-sensitive prefix.

cursor.supports: Cursor encodes the last name as UTF-8 hex; following pages seek name > after, independent of offset and row existence.

expiration.supports: Absolute expiration seconds convert to milliseconds; an omitted deadline becomes null in upsert, and list reports live expirations in seconds.

namespace.supports: Binding creation receives the configured namespace id and source-derived cell name.

namespace_address.supports: Namespace id and shard compose the namespace cell name.

deployment.supports: kv_namespaces accepts binding/id and registers the runtime-supplied SQLite-backed class.

dispatch.supports: The public namespace wrapper uses the runtime-supplied KV Durable Object namespace.

limits.supports: Source limits: 512-byte keys, 25 MiB values, 1 MiB inline threshold, 1024-byte metadata, 100 bulk keys, 1000 list keys.

consistency.supports: This exact source dispatches each read to the owner and implements strong reads while deliberately promising a weaker public freshness contract.
